Name: Corine's Closet - Seasonal Outfits
Author: x3n3as
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/500tW6rx/Corine-Closet.png[/img]﻿

Here's Corine from RSV! I'm really enjoying this project and I'm learning so much from it. Corine's outfits were heavily inspired in 50s fashion, seeing as her original outfit vibes heavily like "50s dinner" to me.

For this reason, all her outfits are dresses, trying to keep with the normal outfits of that time period. I thought that making her Odette for Spirit Week would tie in nicely with Ysabelle, seeing as they are best friends!

As I mentioned last time, the mod itself was writen by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/7439530]Zoedoll[/url], in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9559]Unofficial Ridgeside Village Seasonal Outfits - Alissa[/url].

Last but not least, shout out to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68107072]UndyneWolf[/url] for making [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15488]Kiarra's seasonal closet![/url] - I am still undecided whether I'll make my version of Kiarra, but I know for a  fact that after Corine, I'll be making either Ian or Jeric. If anyone has any ideas for costumes (which I admit are what I struggle with the most), I'd love if you would comment or message me your ideas :).

Anyway, without much further ado, here are the added outfits for Corine:



[img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZYXDNX4H/Corine-Outfits.png[/img]
Thanks again, and see you soon!
